archimate:ValueStream.name: VS-06.1 Plan Dissemination and Access Strategy
archimate:ValueStream.documentation:
The process begins with planning how statistical products will be shared. Teams define who the users are, how they will access the data, and which formats or channels best meet their needs. This includes decisions about whether data will be published openly, shared under restricted access, or provided through secure research environments. It also involves setting release schedules, coordinating with communication teams, and ensuring compliance with release policies and embargo rules. The plan ensures that dissemination is purposeful, consistent, and aligned with user expectations.
Value created: A clear, controlled dissemination plan that balances accessibility with compliance and timing.
